## Where else quarterbacks are discussed

Quarterback content is spread across the guide and is **not** confined to p. 45. When Phase 4 builds the full quarterback database it must sweep all of these:

- **p. 45** — Paul Stone's Top 15, the only ranked quarterback list.
- **pp. 39** — Value in the Heisman Race; quarterback futures prices.
- **Every team spread** — the depth-chart situation, competitions and transfers appear in the season-outlook prose and Three Burning Questions.
- **Team header blocks** — a `*` on the returning-starters line marks a **returning quarterback**, a compact signal worth extracting for all 138 teams.
- **pp. 5–15** — host best bets frequently hinge on quarterback play.
- **pp. 22–27** — Makinen's win-total writeups cite quarterback changes.


> **Open item for Phase 4.** The guide names starting and competing quarterbacks in prose rather than in a structured field, so a complete 138-team quarterback table requires reading every spread. This is planned work, not a gap in the source.
